summary: Iteration 7: Full backend + frontend testing of Ad Spend upload, P&L integration (ad_spend/net_contribution/contribution_margin_pct), and Breakage/Lost-in-Return Claims features. All 14 pytest cases passed; frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright (login -> P&L KPIs -> SKU Costs ad-spend upload testid -> Claims page: scan, KPIs, table, drawer email body/mailto/copy, mark emailed status transition).

issues: Recurring console warnings: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Container has no minWidth/minHeight set for ResponsiveContainer. Cosmetic, not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings by ensuring parent has explicit dimensions or aspect ratio (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: claims.py scan builds oli_map by iterating full sales collection - fine for current size but could be scoped to matched sales_ids for efficiency at scale.

pnl.py _row: ad_spend field is set 0 in _row but overwritten later in pnl_by_sku via pro-rata net_nsv share; net_pnl at SKU level (settlement - product_cost) intentionally does NOT include ad_spend, while summary net_contribution = net_pnl - ad_spend. Documented via test identity - working as designed.
Claims list default limit 500 but frontend requests 1000; endpoint caps at 10000 via Query - OK.
No pagination controls in Claims UI for 14,442 rows; only 1000 rendered. Consider server-side pagination UI or virtualization for perf.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testids present, drawer + status transitions verified)

seed_data_creation: Re-uploaded ad-spend 2026-05=42000, 2026-06=50000 (idempotent upsert). Flipped 1 claim to 'emailed' during UI test and restored to 'open'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features (ad spend + claims) fully working. Backend regression tests in /app/backend/tests/test_ad_spend_claims.py. Expected data: 14,442 open claims at materiality 200, total ~Rs 1.44Cr. P&L 2026-06 ad_spend=50000 confirmed in monthly and summary. mailto/copy/mark-emailed/mark-resolved drawer buttons all wired to PATCH /api/claims/breakage/{id}. No 'kazo' string in rendered DOM.
